summary.headline: Judging Significators and Planetary Conditions
summary.text: Astrological judgment by assessing a house’s significators, its part and lord, their positions and planetary mixtures, and whether they are oriental or occidental, direct or retrograde, angular, succedent, or cadent. Fortunes and impediments—including combustion, descension from exaltation, detriment, conjunctions with infortunes, squares, and oppositions—are used to judge prosperity or misfortune and the increase or decrease of what the signs and houses signify.
